page.overview:
Who is Susie?

Susie is one of the protagonists of Coming Home, the third story in Fazbear Frights 4: Step Closer. She is an empathic young girl with a vivid imagination. A year after her death at the hands of a serial killer, her ghost returns and unknowingly haunts her mother, Patricia, and younger sister, Samantha.

Susie had light-brown hair that flowed around her face and brown eyes that were usually wide open, making her look eager. She also often looked wild and mischievous. Susie was usually called cute because of her small nose and mouth. Her ears were pierced and she liked to wear pretty-colored earrings. Susie had a scar at the top of her forehead hidden under her hair. Susie and Samantha are the same height despite Susie being a year older.

Susie was wearing a magenta-and-pink striped sweater and jeans embedded with rhinestones when she was murdered.Fazbear Frights #4: Step Closer | Coming Home | "She looked the same way she’d looked the day she was abducted. She even wore the same clothes—her magenta-and-pink striped sweater and the jeans Jeanie had studded with

rhinestones." She wears the same clothes when she meets with Samantha.
